Book flights with an agent (with a failed email entry)
One commenter had Muse book flights but it entered the email wrong, so no confirmation arrived; a partial success.
·
Nov 18, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
A commenter said they used Muse to book flights, but the agent entered their email address incorrectly during the booking. After no confirmation arrived, they had Muse call the airline and sit on hold to get the mistake fixed.
How it went
It was only a partial success: the flights were booked, but the bad email meant the confirmation never reached them. The recovery worked only after an extra call to the airline.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Find and book a flight from [origin] to [destination] departing [date] and returning [date] for [number] traveler(s), with a budget of [price] and preference for [nonstop, time of day, airline]. Use my email [email] for the confirmation. Before entering payment details or finalizing, pause and show me the itinerary, price, and the email address you typed so I can check it, then confirm that a confirmation page appeared.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseAgent/comments/1xzovg3/what_are_some_terrible_experiences_youve_had_with
